## Code

### P1 "VolumeToVoxels" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Samples a 3D volume texture and emits a voxel point cloud for cells above a density threshold. Each solid cell becomes a point with position and color sampled from the volume. Pipeline: 3D Volume Generator → VolumeToVoxels → MeshInstancer → InstancedMeshLighting (or any mesh renderer).; categories: Generator, 3D, Volume, Voxel; resources: geoOut:geometry

```glsl
void main()
{
  uint idx = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
  uint res = uint(resolution);
  uint totalVoxels = res * res * res;
  if(idx >= totalVoxels)
    return;
    

  // Linear index → 3D grid coordinate
  uint z = idx / (res * res);
  uint y = (idx / res) % res;
  uint x = idx % res;

  // Sample volume at cell center (normalized [0,1]³)
  vec3 uvw = (vec3(x, y, z) + 0.5) / float(res);
  vec4 samp = texture(volume, uvw);

  // Density: prefer alpha channel, fall back to luminance
  float density = samp.a;
  if(density < 0.001)
    density = dot(samp.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));

  // World position: centered on origin, scaled
  vec3 pos = (uvw - 0.5) * scale;

  if(density > threshold)
  {
    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_position)[idx] = vec4(pos, 1.0);
    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_color)[idx] = vec4(samp.rgb, 1.0);
  }
  else
  {
    // Empty cell — push off-screen so instancer/renderer skips it
    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_position)[idx] = vec4(1e10, 1e10, 1e10, 0.0);
    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_color)[idx] = vec4(0.0);
  }
}
```

### P3 "04-10_heat_diffusion" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: 3D heat equation: ∂u/∂t = α ∇²u. Simplest possible persistent-3D sim. A hot source voxel continuously injects energy, it spreads outward. Useful as a reference test for the persistent plumbing and as a building block (feed the output into a warp filter etc).; categories: 3D-GENERATOR, SIMULATION; inputs: alpha:float=0.15, sourcePos:point3D=[0,0,0], sourceSize:float=0.1, sourceTemp:float=1, ambient:float=0, coolRate:float=0.995, clear:event; resources: state:image

### P5 "08-01_domain_warp_noise" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Domain warp by a noise offset: sample input at p + noise(p). Melts / swirls the volume. The output is rgba16f, so signed and HDR inputs (01-15 curl noise, the simulations, 07-06 Laplacian...) pass through without clipping.; categories: 3D-FILTER, WARP; inputs: volIn:texture, amount:float=0.15, scale:float=3, drift:float=0.2; resources: volOut:image
